standard_prerequisites: the exact sequence of completed naive cotangent complexes for A -> B -> C and the induced map on H^{-1} (lemma-exact-sequence-NL of the same chapter, including its presentation diagram)
presentations of adic topologically finite type algebras B = A{x_1,...,x_r}/J, C = B{y_1,...,y_s}/J' and C = A{x,y}/K over the completed polynomial rings
rig-smooth implies rig-flat, so the ideal (K/J)_q is generated by a regular sequence at the relevant primes (lemma-rig-smooth-rig-flat of the same chapter)
the conormal sequence of an ideal generated by a regular sequence is H_1-regular (More on Algebra, Lemma more-algebra-lemma-conormal-sequence-H1-regular-ideal and its section on ideals)
core_obligations: Prove that if B -> C is rig-smooth, then the kernel of the map H^{-1}(NL^wedge_{B/A} tensor_B C) -> H^{-1}(NL^wedge_{C/A}) is annihilated by an ideal of definition
proof_roadmap: The modules in question are finite, so annihilation by an ideal of definition is checked at primes qbar not containing an ideal of definition, where it suffices to prove injectivity of the localized connecting map.

Via the presentations and the diagram in the proof of lemma-exact-sequence-NL this reduces to injectivity of J/J^2 tensor_B C -> K/K^2 after localization at the prime q, equivalently J_q intersect K^2_q = (KJ)_q.

Rig-smoothness gives that (K/J)_q = J'_q is generated by a regular sequence; the H_1-regular conormal sequence lemma from More on Algebra yields the required intersection identity, finishing the proof.
difficulty_reason: H3: a presentation-level reduction of an exactness statement to a conormal-sequence intersection identity, discharged by the regular-sequence lemma.
